content_sections.heading: About Jamia Hamdard
content_sections.text: Jamia Hamdard is a Deemed to be University at Hamdard Nagar, New Delhi, and its letterhead states that it is accredited by NAAC in the 'A+' category. This requirement is for its School of Pharmaceutical Education and Research (SPER), where the selected Guest/Visiting Faculty will teach the subjects listed above to B.Pharm students.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The post is for teaching Basics of Python Programming, Basics of Computer Sciences, AI and Machine Learning (ML) and Data Analytics for B.Pharm.

rows.department: School of Pharmaceutical Education and Research (SPER)

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Desirable qualification: Ph.D. Degree in relevant discipline. Experience of teaching Basics of Python Programming, Basics of Computer Sciences, AI and Machine Learning (ML) and Data Analytics should be preferred. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.qualification: Essential (from a UGC recognized University/Institution only): (i) B.E./B.Tech./B.S. and M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or Integrated M.Tech. in relevant branch with First Class or equivalent in any one of the degrees; OR B.E./B.Tech. and M.C.A. with first class or equivalent in any one of the two degrees. (ii) Cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET/GPAT/GATE.
rows.experience: No essential experience printed. Experience of teaching Basics of Python Programming, Basics of Computer Sciences, AI and Machine Learning (ML) and Data Analytics should be preferred.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Remuneration/Salary: as per Jamia Hamdard norms. No amount is printed in the notice. Engagement: one Guest/Visiting Faculty on purely temporary basis. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further selection procedures.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Jamia Hamdard Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the attached application format (Advt. No. FR- 15/2026 & Date: 11.11.2026), which also carries a declaration, the candidate's signature and a space for a recent coloured photo. Prepare an updated CV and the supporting documents. Combine the application, CV and supporting documents in a single PDF. Email the PDF to [email protected] on or before 20 November 2026. The application format asks for: post applied for the subject/discipline; name; father's/husband's name; date of birth; marital status; gender; permanent and communication addresses with phone and email; educational qualifications in chronological order from Secondary School onwards (degree, subject(s), specialization, division, percentage of marks, year of passing, university/institution); whether NET/GATE qualified (Yes/No) with details; and employment records in chronological order starting from the present job (organization name and address, designation, period, nature of duties, pay scale/details).

content_sections.text: Application in the attached format, with a recent coloured photo pasted Updated CV Supporting documents All of the above in a single PDF

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are open in Jamia Hamdard Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Jamia Hamdard will engage one (01) Guest/Visiting Faculty in the School of Pharmaceutical Education and Research (SPER), Post Code 001.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must be emailed on or before 20 November 2026. Applications received after the last date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What subjects will the Guest/Visiting Faculty teach?
faq.answer: The faculty will teach Basics of Python Programming, Basics of Computer Sciences, AI and Machine Learning (ML) and Data Analytics for B.Pharm.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: B.E./B.Tech./B.S. and M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or Integrated M.Tech. in relevant branch with First Class or equivalent in any one of the degrees, OR B.E./B.Tech. and M.C.A. with first class or equivalent in any one of the two degrees. The candidate must also have cleared NET (UGC or CSIR) or a similar UGC-accredited test like SLET/SET/GPAT/GATE.

faq.question: Q5. Is a Ph.D. compulsory?
faq.answer: No. A Ph.D. Degree in relevant discipline is listed as a desirable qualification, not an essential one.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email the attached application format with an updated CV and supporting documents in a single PDF to [email protected] on or before 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the Guest/Visiting Faculty post?
faq.answer: The notice says Remuneration/Salary is as per Jamia Hamdard norms. No amount is printed.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent post?
faq.answer: No. Jamia Hamdard will engage the faculty on a purely temporary basis.

faq.question: Q9. Will all applicants be called for the next stage?
faq.answer: No. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further selection procedures, and no correspondence will be entertained about reasons for not being called.
